signals.advanceTell: Companion observations note warm wind reversing along waterways before the cloud wall appears.
signals.activeEvidence: Heavy rain, swollen crossings, reduced sight, and accelerated living growth affect visible routes.
signals.aftermathClue: Fresh flood lines and rooted debris show exactly which tethers carried the front.
signals.accessibilitySubstitute: Map labels announce the approaching front, affected connections, intensity, and mechanical travel warning without relying on color or audio.
